# Approval

`schemas/records/approval.json`

An approval record (docs/design/m0/04 "Approval records"): who approved which action on which exact object state, under which grant and confirmation. change_class is computed by internal/authority from the effective change, never supplied. Approvals are append-only; supersedes is explicit lineage, and a revocation or narrower scope wins over an earlier, wider one.

## Definitions

### ChangeClass

Sensitive change classes and their supervisor confirmation defaults are in docs/design/m0/04 (D32, K5, KA1, M12).

Type: one of `install.self`, `policy.widen_data`, `policy.widen_destinations`, `policy.weaken_protection`, `capacity.allow_paid_fallback`, `agent.enrol`, `grant.create`, `grant.extend`, `knowledge.accept_claim`, `knowledge.export_framework_prose`, `knowledge.change_protected_document`, `integration.change_topology`

### ObjectRef

The exact object the action applies to: its version, its digest, or both, never neither (version 0: the object does not exist yet).

#### Fields of ObjectRef

|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) |  |

| `version` | yes | null or integer (minimum `0`, maximum `9007199254740991`) |  |
| `digest` | yes | null or [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (1, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `version` `null`, then `digest` any (not `null`)
